title: Psychedelic TV Smile
description: A vintage wooden television set displays a surreal psychedelic painting featuring a large blue smiling face with orange eyes and mouth. The composition is filled with hanging wind chimes, spirals, roses, colorful flowers, and abstract female faces against a swirling dark background.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic painting displayed on the screen of a vintage wooden television. The central subject is a large bright blue smiling face with bold orange eyes and mouth. Surrounding it are hanging metallic wind chimes, black and white spirals, red roses, vibrant orange and purple flowers, and stylized female faces with blue skin. Dark swirling smoke and abstract geometric shapes fill the background in a vibrant, dreamlike composition.
